cards.name: Musical Theatre Summer Camps
cards.description: Campers rehearse and perform a children's musical and participate in acting, singing, dancing, set design, costume design, and theatre crafts. Each session ends with a performance for friends and family.

financial_aid.text: Financial Aid Scholarships are available for families in need who apply. Financial Aid resources are limited and cannot be guaranteed.

lunch.text: If this is offered again in 2026 PGS will be participating. Be prepared to pack your child a lunch and a snack each day that does not need to be refrigerated or heated if you do not wish to participate or if the program is not available in 2026.

cards.name: Counselor In Training
cards.description: Teen volunteers learn theatre education, backstage theatre arts, and theatre administration. They help campers with lines and choreography, lead theatre games, and create props, backdrops, and costumes.
